text:
aj: Posting a proposal for per-org rate limit policy — would love quick feedback.

aj: Summary: per-org limits are primary, per-key secondary. Enforce RPM + TPM (tokens/min) + concurrency caps. Support short bursts.

sana: TPM = tokens per minute? we currently bill on tokens.

kevin: yep TPM = tokens/min. caveat: streaming endpoints don't always report tokens at the edge — we should fallback to RPM there.

maria: embeddings can burst on short windows. propose burst window (10s) + burst_multiplier.

aj: Proposed defaults:
- free: 60 RPM, 30k TPM, concurrency 4
- pro: 600 RPM, 300k TPM, concurrency 20
- enterprise: negotiated (soft limits + reserved capacity)
Burst: allow 2x RPM for 30s. Enforcement model: token-bucket per-org + concurrency semaphore.

sana: console needs: current usage, per-route breakdown, throttle history, request for quota increase flow.

kevin: telemetry: emit rate_limit.event with fields org_id, limit_type, route, overage. sampling: 100% enterprise, 1% baseline.

maria: runtime behavior: 429 with Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers. For streaming, either abort stream with 429 or downgrade to summary response.

aj: Rollout plan: flag org.rate_policy.v2 -> beta for 10 orgs -> 25% -> 100%. Proxy implements token est. + concurrency guard.

kevin: For private deployments we should ship same controls via config. Sample policy:
```json
{
  "org_id": "*",
  "rpm": 600,
  "tpm": 300000,
  "concurrency": 20,
  "burst_multiplier": 2
}
```

sana: add admin overrides + emergency circuit-breaker to tighten or relax caps.

maria: I'll mock the quota UX and add a 'burst_throttled' event to support tooling.

aj: assigning: @kevin telemetry, @maria UX, @sana policy review. I'll open PR with policy structs and proxy hooks.

kevin: ack. will add dashboards (per-org rate, per-route errors/429s) and links for support.

sana: nit: rename TPM to tokens_per_minute in console labels for clarity.

aj: done — will update naming in the PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
